FRIERENMOD-FLOW.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Put one Mana from your draw pile and one from your discard pile into your hand.

FRIERENMOD-RAPID_CHANT.description:

FRIERENMOD-FINAL_CHANT.description: Chant at maximum intensity in your draw pile, hand, and discard pile, in that order.

FRIERENMOD-DISCARD_CHANT_CHOICE.descript: Exhaust {ManaCost} Mana from your discard pile. {Effect}

FRIERENMOD-CONTINUAL_CHANT.title: Continual Chant

Shuffle {Intensity} Mana into your Draw Pile, then Chant {Intensity}.
FRIERENMOD-FLOWER_FIELD_SPELL.title: Flower Field Spell
FRIERENMOD-FLOWER_FIELD_SPELL.descriptio: Chant 2. Add {Upgraded:cond:an upgraded|a} Blue Moon Weed to your Hand.

FRIERENMOD-MANA_BARRICADE.title: Mana Barricade

FRIERENMOD-LURE_THE_ENEMY_IN_DEEP.title: Lure The Enemy In Deep
FRIERENMOD-LURE_THE_ENEMY_IN_DEEP.descri: Chant {Intensity}. Gain {Intensity} Energy. If you activate the Hand slot, return this card to your Hand.

FRIERENMOD-FULL_AHEAD.title: Full Ahead
FRIERENMOD-FULL_AHEAD.description: The first time you activate a factor each turn, gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity.

FRIERENMOD-SIMMERING.description: Whenever you activate a factor, draw 1 Legendary Spell from your Draw Pile.
FRIERENMOD-HALF_THE_SKY.title: Envy
FRIERENMOD-HALF_THE_SKY.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Whenever you activate a factor, return this card from your Discard Pile to your Hand.

FRIERENMOD-CONFRONTATION.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Each Chant card played while this is in your Hand increases its base Block by 3 this combat.

FRIERENMOD-IMAGINATION.description:
This turn, Chants are free and you cannot generate Mana.
Pay normal card costs with Mana.
FRIERENMOD-PREPARED_POSTURE.title: Prepared Posture
FRIERENMOD-PREPARED_POSTURE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Draw 1 Chant card from your Draw Pile.

FRIERENMOD-FOLK_GRIMOIRE.description: Add a random Chant card and a random Legendary Spell to your Hand. They cost {Discount} less this turn.
FRIERENMOD-HELL_FIRE_SUMMONING.title: Hellfire Summoning
FRIERENMOD-HELL_FIRE_SUMMONING.descripti:
[gold]Sealed[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice per Chant card played this turn.
Costs 1 more this turn after each play.
FRIERENMOD-FAMEHAMEHA.title: Famehameha Wave
FRIERENMOD-FAMEHAMEHA.description:
[gold]Legendary Spell[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Each factor activation reduces this card's cost by 1 this turn.
FRIERENMOD-FAIRY_TALE_END.title: The end of Fairy Tale
FRIERENMOD-FAIRY_TALE_END.description:
[gold]Legendary Spell[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Each distinct Legendary Spell in your deck doubles base damage (included).
FRIERENMOD-HOT_TEA_SPELL.title: Spell to Produce Hot Tea
